scope: Read-only prerequisite audit of the named integration boundaries and relevant definitions, call sites, tests and retained evidence. This is not an entire-codebase audit or M12 implementation.

dependencies.finding: The shared strict evidence schema, command recorder, source locking and regression machinery exist. Current commands are recorded separately; historical Windows baseline failures are not current passing evidence.

Service.tool routes ordinary calls through a per-Service authority/ledger when enabled. invoke lacks parentInvocationId/receipt/per-call cancellation inputs; admit accepts parent linkage but does not authorize. Dedupe does not implement complete M12 owner/definition equality. Native skill/plugin sub-effects have documented gaps.

No concrete approved ExecutionBackend or composed production consumer. Synthetic launch mocks are not platform proof. No selected backend enforces a 128 MiB memory bound, arbitrary-code filesystem/network/process restrictions, or an approved Python profile.

Catalog pagination accepts no owner/visibility context; Pi and official MCP expose the full supplied tool list. No integrated progressive visibility contract or current M04 evidence/tests on this base. Draft PR 326 is not an accepted dependency.

publishData and runtime bridges return complete DataRecord values; Store.snapshot includes them. Existing research passage, filesystem grant, effect-outcome and workspace-summary APIs do not establish generic private tool-result handles with the same grants.

historicalSourceDrift.interpretation: Historical source proof is stale; inspected additions are recorded, not independently approved. Existing M02 ledger and effect-schema APIs are present. This is not checkout corruption.
